Claim: session `session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S` · branch `claude/issue-8394-remaining-emptiness-spellings`

PM dispatch (`domain:ui` seat). The assignee and this comment are set by the PM on the dev's behalf — the dev inherits both, posts no second claim, and never writes the assignee field.

**Unblocked:** objectui#8376 / PR #8396 has landed (verified by content — `hasCellValue` now appears 5× in `DetailSection.tsx`), so the shared authority exists and `DetailSection`'s three spellings are already converged.

⛔ **Do not repeat the mistake PR #8396's dispatch nearly caused.** My brief there ruled "delegate to `recordDisplayValueAt` wholesale"; measurement proved that **wrong at a cell**, and PR #8396 shipped a scalar/object split instead. `recordDisplayValueAt` answers *"does this resolve to a NAME"* — an object runs through `displayNameOfEmbeddedObject` and is EMPTY when that yields nothing, while a cell hands objects to type-aware renderers (location, address, select badges, JSON, repeater), none of which carries a name-ish key. **Read `hasCellValue`'s docblock in `DetailSection.tsx` before converging anything.**

⚠️ **Each of the four sites may be asking a different question.** `HeaderHighlight.tsx` (the ADR-0085 strip), `DetailView.tsx`'s `summaryFields` chips, `RecordMetaFooter.tsx` and `HistoryTimeline.tsx` are four surfaces, not one. Converge only where the question really is the same, and say so per site. Where it is not, say what it is instead — a report naming three convergences and one genuine difference is a better result than four forced ones.

The card notes `HeaderHighlight.tsx:171` will be, after PR #8396, **the only band on the page still calling a whitespace-only value FILLED** — it sits between the H1 and the body grid, so the inconsistency is visible in one screenful.
